statement: ∀ X : ℕ, (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)^2) ≤ Real.exp (Real.pi^2) * (1 + Real.log (X : ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 控制共振分母权重 q/φ(q)² 的累积量，对所有截断点给出显式对数上界。
plain_statement.en: Bound the cumulative resonance weight q/φ(q)² logarithmically with an explicit constant at every cutoff.

brief.zh: 利用欧拉乘积将 (q/φ(q))² 逐因子放大为 1+6/p，按素因子子集展开。子集乘积 D 的倍数对调和和的贡献至多为 Hₓ/D，因此剩余乘积被 exp(6Σₚ1/p²) 控制。与单分母的共振分子比例界相乘，得到长周期奇因子分母族的加权总量。常数取便于核验的非最优值。
brief.en: Majorize each Euler factor of (q/φ(q))² by 1+6/p and expand over subsets of prime factors. Multiples of the subset product D carry at most Hₓ/D harmonic mass. The resulting product is bounded by exp(6Σₚ1/p²). Multiplication by a per-denominator resonance fraction bounds the weighted long-factor population; the explicit constant is not optimized.
